title: RiceTFtarget: A rice transcription factor-target prediction server based on coexpression and machine learning.
authors: Zhang, Baoyi; Zhu, Xueai; Chen, Zixin; Zhang, Hongsheng; Huang, Junxian; Huang, Ji
one_liner_zh: 该研究开发了基于共表达和机器学习的水稻转录因子靶基因预测服务器，虽聚焦TF-DNA靶标预测但缺乏三维互作建模与机制研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测。
